name: Akune (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Akune city emblem in white: a ring open at the top enclosing a stylised figure with a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Akune, a city in Kagoshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 April 1952.

features.role: Akune city emblem — a ring open at the top enclosing a stylised figure with a disc
